div.div:
Entities
Generated from the database schema by docs/architecture/diagrams/entities.py. Every table also has created_at and updated_at, except poll_voters and referendum_voters (no timestamps, so a vote's timing can't reveal it) and qr_scans (created_at only). referendable and replyable are polymorphic, so have no lines. policies.replaces_policy_id points to another policy.
